author: The Critical Drinker
description:
It was supposed to be Arnold's big comeback after a two year hiatus from moviemaking, but Peter Hyam's 1999 action horror flick wasn't quite the roaring success everyone hoped for. Was it a misunderstood classic or just a badly paced mess? Join me and DarkHour as we try to make sense of this misfiring Schwarzenegger vehicle. 

Subscribe to DarkHour: https://www.youtube.com/@DarkHourYT
